task: M1 regularized shared-feature UFC binary fight-winner probability validation

source.m0_comparator_policy: Consume the authoritative frozen M0 OOF artifact; do not numerically recompute its raw probabilities under a later dependency solve.

feature_policy.eligible_surface: All frozen F02 schema columns with predictor=true are audited mechanically.
feature_policy.model_input: All 96 fighter-specific f1/f2 source pairs plus all 5 matchup predictors, excluding the three shared fight-context predictors from the model matrix.
feature_policy.diagnostic_context: The excluded shared fight-context predictors remain available only for predefined reporting slices.
feature_policy.selection: No outcome-driven feature selection, ablation-driven pruning, coefficient-threshold pruning, or performance-reactive feature revision is allowed in M1.

preprocessing.fighter_side_pairs: Pair f1/f2 by exact F02 source_materialized_name. Fit one pooled median on the current training fold only, impute both sides with that shared median, then emit f1-minus-f2 and missing(f1)-missing(f2).
preprocessing.directional_matchup_pairs: Pair f1_vs_f2/f2_vs_f1 matchup values by exact mirrored source_materialized_name. Use the same pooled-training-median value-difference and missingness-difference projection.
preprocessing.reach_difference: The already-oriented reach-difference matchup feature is used directly; missing values receive neutral zero model-space imputation and no symmetric missingness flag so fighter-swap antisymmetry is preserved.
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler(with_mean=false) fit on each training fold only.
preprocessing.orientation: Every M1 model input is antisymmetric under fighter swap; fit_intercept=false. Exact p(f1)+p(swapped f1)=1 is a hard test.

model.regularization_selection: For each outer fold, choose C using only that outer training set with expanding chronological inner annual OOF folds beginning in 2013. Primary inner selection metric is pooled inner-OOF log loss. Exact ties choose smaller C.

comparators: 50/50 from the authoritative frozen M0 OOF artifact
M0 empirical experience baseline from the authoritative frozen M0 OOF artifact
frozen M0 logistic loaded from Actions run 34676508116 artifact 10292502486 and required to match the frozen M0 OOF logical SHA-256

verdict_rule.M1_OUTPERFORMS_M0: M1 improves aggregate log loss and Brier versus frozen M0 and improves both primary metrics in at least two-thirds of outer folds.
verdict_rule.M1_MIXED_VS_M0: M1 improves at least one aggregate primary metric but does not satisfy the stable-both-metrics rule.
verdict_rule.M1_DOES_NOT_OUTPERFORM_M0: M1 improves neither aggregate primary metric versus frozen M0.

forbidden: ROI, Kelly, bet thresholds, price buckets, or sportsbook targeting
tree, boosting, neural, ensemble, AutoML, or nonlinear challenger models
opponent adjustment beyond the frozen F02 feature surface
fighter IDs, target fields, or identity/provenance columns in the model matrix
changes to F00, F01, F02, M0, frozen DATA, or market-diagnostic branches
